full_text:
Thornstaff is a spell that enables the user to transform an object into a staff-like weapon.

History

Marduk used this spell while in the Pyramid of the Sun to transform a torch into a staff with a spiked crook on one end and with a spear on the other. [The Titan in the Temple of Sun]

International Names

'''Thornstaff''' is a [[spell]] that enables the user to transform an object into a staff-like weapon.

== History ==
Marduk used this spell while in the [[Pyramid of the Sun]] to transform a torch into a staff with a spiked crook on one end and with a spear on the other. {{source|The Titan in the Temple of Sun}}
